# V20 authentic Korean banknote garment palette

Built-in image-generation edit of the approved V19 sprite. The four real Korean banknote scans were supplied as colour references: 1,000-won blue, 5,000-won reddish-brown, 10,000-won green, 50,000-won yellow/ochre. Every outfit mixes these four families across its existing fragments. Purple/teal/electric-blue garment colours were replaced; the frontal identities, complete poses and six-cell layout remain the reference.

The foreground is derivative collage artwork. Actual 10,000-won scans still form the background. The active renderer differs from V19 only in the sprite asset path and header comment; the complete motion/render implementation and uniform sprite crop are unchanged.

Validation: six poses and paper-bend samples inspected; native preview screenshot saved; 173 renderer frames exported at 24 fps. Parent workspace outputs: design-output/v20-contact.png, v20-palette-preview.png and sejong-flipbook-v20-motion.png. Prompt: design-output/v20-image-prompt.txt. Changes remain local.
